# Beacon Change Request Email Paste

## Customer Request

From: Dana Lee, Beacon Analytics.

Date: 2026-05-18.

Dana asked whether the team can add a custom executive dashboard before launch.

The request estimates 22 extra hours for dashboard design and metric mapping.

Dana wrote that Beacon wants the work started this week but has not sent a
signed change order.

## Internal Reply

Sales wrote, "sounds fine verbally," but Legal replied that verbal approval does
not amend SOW-14.

Finance flagged that the request should be priced at the SOW out-of-scope rate
unless a signed change order says otherwise.

## Open Status

Signed change order: not received.

Work authorization status: hold until signed change order arrives.
